sections.title: Sound of eff
paragraphs: The letter name is (eff) /ɛf/. Its main sound is heard in (fa) /ˈfɒ/, which means tree, wood. This letter has only one sound in Hungarian. It always sounds clear and steady.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: A consonant is a sound made when the mouth blocks or narrows the air. Put your upper teeth gently on your lower lip. Blow air through the narrow gap. Keep your voice off. Touch your throat to check that it does not shake.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the same sound in all regular positions. You can hear it at the start of (fa) /ˈfɒ/. You also hear it clearly in (fül) /ˈfyl/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: This sound is just like the sound in the English word fish. There are no real pitfalls for this letter.
